reading.zh: 从左到右：constants 定常量与路径，http-handler 解析并路由请求，server 承载回环监听，bootstrap 拉起进程；箭头是请求自常量流向进程引导。
reading.en: Left to right: constants fix paths and constants, http-handler parses and routes requests, server hosts the loopback listener and bootstrap starts the process; arrows show the request flowing from constants to process bootstrap.
